chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Hishām ibn Sālim, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام saw a storyteller in the mosque, so he struck him with the whip and drove him out.

key_terms.أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amīr al-Muʾminīn, the title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.فَطَرَدَهُ: so he expelled him or drove him away
key_terms.قَاصًّا: a storyteller or public tale-narrator addressing people
key_terms.ٱلدِّرَّةِ: a disciplinary whip or lash used for rebuke
key_terms.ٱلْمَسْجِدِ: the mosque, the sacred communal place of worship

ai.seo_question: What did Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام do when he saw a storyteller in the mosque?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام expelled a qāṣṣ from the mosque by disciplinary force. It indicates disapproval of unauthorized storytelling or public religious speech in the mosque and reflects the Imam’s authority in regulating the sanctity and function of the mosque.
